issue-4191: README says npm run serve, but that script doesn't exist
Opened by new-contributor-ana on 2026-09-02

Following the README's "Running locally" section, `npm run serve` fails with
"Missing script: serve". Is there another command I should be using?

args.title: Fix README to use npm start instead of nonexistent npm run serve
args.body: File: README.md. The "Running locally" section tells users to run `npm run serve`, but package.json has no `serve` script, only `start` (which runs `node dist/index.js`). Update README.md's instructions to use `npm start` instead of `npm run serve` so the documented command actually works.
